title: The Daily Howl: Home Opener, and Kawhi Comes to Town
text:

 Skip to content TWOLVES BLOG Timberwolves Game Coverage Daily Howl Lynx Injury Report Schedules Wolvespedia The Daily Howl The Daily Howl: Home Opener, and Kawhi Comes to Town
 The 2-0 Wolves finally come home to face Kawhi Leonard and a 2-0 Toronto team in tonight's Target Center opener, plus Olivia Miles makes All-WNBA First Team.
 TWolves Blog Staff October 25, 2026 · 2 min read Two road wins banked, and now the Wolves finally come home — to find Kawhi Leonard and a 2-0 Toronto team waiting. Something gives at Target Center tonight.
 The Links
 TSN: Kawhi, Raptors Visit New-Look T-Wolves Sunday — two unbeaten teams collide; Kawhi’s still working into shape (16 on 7-of-20 vs. Washington) while Ant and LaMelo aren’t waiting on anyone.
 Canis Hoopus: Game Preview #3 — Wolves vs. Raptors — the Melo-vs-Kawhi, Ant-vs-Scottie Barnes breakdown ahead of the home opener.
 TWolves Blog: Wolves 115, Magic 93 — Edwards Bricks, Bench Rolls — how Minnesota swept Florida without Ant’s jumper, out-rebounding Orlando 60-43.
 TWolves Blog: The Pursuit Team — A New Wolves Identity, or Noise? — whether this effort-and-depth look is the real separator or an October mirage.
 CBS Minnesota: Olivia Miles First Rookie in Lynx History to Make All-WNBA First Team — unanimous ROY, a record 790 rookie points, and now the seventh Lynx player ever on the First Team.
 Yahoo Sports: Clark, Miles, Wilson Lead 2026 All-WNBA First Team — Miles the only first-timer on a team with Wilson, Stewart, Clark and Mitchell.
 FOX 9: Home Opener Set for Oct. 25, Franchise-Record Homestand Ahead — Minnesota has won 10 straight home openers, and an eight-game stay at home runs Nov. 8-23.
 Listen & Watch
 Locked On Wolves (Ben Beecken) — daily pod setting the table for the home opener and a 2-0 start that keeps winning ugly.
 The Dane Moore NBA Podcast — reported takes on whether the depth travels into tougher matchups.
